facts.fact: The 2020 US political cycle was the most expensive for advertising in its history, according to the vendor's blog post.
facts.quote: The 2020 US political cycle turned out to be the most expensive for advertising in its history.

facts.fact: Spending for both presidential and congressional races in the 2020 cycle smashed records, and a big part of that spend went to digital.
facts.quote: Spending for both presidential and congressional races smashed records—and a big part of those campaign spends went to digital.

facts.fact: Programmatic guaranteed is a DSP feature in which the advertiser pays a flat negotiated CPM for the inventory it purchases.
facts.quote: The advertiser pays a flat negotiated CPM for the inventory that they are purchasing.

facts.fact: Programmatic guaranteed facilitates one-to-one deals between publishers and advertisers, with the publisher setting aside inventory for the advertiser.
facts.quote: Programmatic guaranteed (PG) is a feature offered by DSPs that facilitates one-to-one deals between the publishers and advertisers.

facts.fact: Geo radius targeting in the vendor's DSP can be customized down to the mile or kilometre to target users in mobile in-app environments.
facts.quote: Customize your radius down to the mile or kilometre to target users in mobile in-app environments.

facts.fact: Cross-channel retargeting delivers ads to a user based on their previous intent-based actions on the web.
facts.quote: Retargeting enables you to deliver ads to a user based on their previous intent-based actions on the web.

facts.fact: The article states that the 2024 US presidential election is fast approaching.
facts.quote: The 2024 US presidential election is fast approaching, but don’t stress!

facts.fact: The article lists 12 features for running political ad campaigns.
facts.quote: In my experience, these 12 features make all the difference in running political campaigns that reach the right voters.

facts.fact: The article says political ads should consider DAA and DAAC compliance.
facts.quote: It’s important to consider DAA and DAAC compliance for your political ads.

facts.fact: According to the article, a programmatic platform can embed or display the political ad disclosure when a user hovers over the ad.
facts.quote: Leverage a programmatic platform, like StackAdapt, that offers the ability to both embed or display your disclosure when hovering over the ad.

facts.fact: The article says post-campaign reporting for persuasion lift includes survey results, geo breakdown, audience breakdown, creative breakdown, and creative impact.
facts.quote: Post-campaign reporting will include data that covers survey results, geo breakdown, audience breakdown, creative breakdown, creative impact, and more.

facts.fact: The article defines contextual advertising as targeting ads based on the environment in which the ad appears rather than user behaviour.
facts.quote: Rather than targeting ads based on user behaviour, contextual advertising targets ads based on the environment in which the ad appears.
